title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theatre on 1971-02-20
source: 7" 2-track Betty Reel w/ dolby A @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM501ES @ 44.056 KHz PCM501ES analog out > dolby A decoder > analog in Fostex D5 @ 48KHz > DATx32

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear 1971 soundboard capture featuring Garcia’s wah‑wah‑laden Sugar Magnolia and a uniquely ending Wharf Rat.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers an excellent, classic ’71 soundboard mix with remarkably clear guitar lines—Jerry’s tone is described as “fat” and even features a wah‑wah pedal on Sugar Magnolia. Reviewers highlight the psychedelic adventure of the show, especially the one‑of‑a‑kind ending to Wharf Rat, and overall describe the performance as high‑energy and superb.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive (average 4.67 stars) and praise both the musical performance and the pristine soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with every guitar line audible; classic 1971 soundboard character praised. No technical flaws reported, though reviewers suggest EQ tweaks for optimal playback.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure, but reviewers note a consistently high‑energy, psychedelic vibe throughout the performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar shines with a fat single‑coil tone; uses a wah‑wah pedal on Sugar Magnolia and is praised for being crystal‑clear in the mix.
